title: Name, birth date and birthplace
summary: Morgan states his name and that he was born 7 April 1897 in Louisiana, 28 miles down the Mississippi.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I wonder if we could start out by asking your name, you know, just state your name and your age when you were born. And we'll have that on the tape then.

My name is Isaiah Morgan. Born 1897. Seventh day of April. And where were you born? In Bytranville, Louisiana. That's down the country. That's twenty-eight miles down the Mississippi River. On this side? Yeah.
